To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the cell cycle times were 48 to 60 hr regardless of stage; (2) the cell cycle was not altered in blastic crisis; (3) maturation of the blast cell line was delayed in blastic crisis, with early appearance of mature cells; and (4) the blast cells were capable of phagocyte function.
the cell cycle time is not prolonged in chronic myelocytie leukemia (CML) blast cells and the cell cycle time of CML blast cells is similar to that of normal marrow cells.
the cell cycle time of blast cells from Ph1-positive CML patients is similar to that of normal bone marrow cells and that the blast cells are capable of phagocyte activity.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the maturation of the myeloid cell series in vitro, with emphasis on the relationship between maturation and phagocytic function of leukocytes in chronic myelocytie leukemia.
the cell cycle characteristics, maturation, and phagocytotic ability of blast cells from patients with chronic granulocytic leukemia.
the study of the maturation of the granulocytic cell in chronic myelocid leukemia.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
in chronic myelocyclic leukemia the cells have a normal cell cycle time, but there are some differences in cell cycle characteristics, maturation, and phagocytoses.
the cell lines of chronic myelocytosis are not homogeneous and that the Ph1 chromosome does not determine the cell cycle time.
the cell cycle times of leukocytes in Ph1-positive chronic leukemia are normal and that the cell cycle is not prolonged.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the cell cycle times of the cells from the patients with Ph1 positive chronic myelocitic leukemia (CML) are longer than the normal cells.
the cell cycle times of the leukemic cells in the Ph1-positive chronic granulocytic leukemia were similar to the cell cycle times for the normal granulocyte precursors.

the cell cycle times were normal for the cells from the patients with Ph1 chromosome in chronic myelocytic leukemia and the maturation of the cells from the patient in blastic transformation was delayed.

the cells of CML are very different from normal cells.
